Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the birth date format, interpreting “10/06/1819” as October 6, 1819 instead of June 10, 1819. This date-format confusion (MM/DD vs DD/MM) led to the incorrect conclusion of October 6, 1819, despite Britannica explicitly showing “June 10, 1819” and Wikipedia listing “10 June 1819.”
